title: Grateful Dead Live at Fillmore East on 1970-09-19
taper: DAT from "3 Decades of Dead" Tree
source: SBD > Reel(0) > DAT > Mac (via Lucid PCI24) > CD-R

ai_review.summary: Audience‑taped recording with okay overall sound that truly shines on the second‑set Dark Star > St. Stephen > Turn On Your Love Light, delivering a classic ’70s Dead experience.
ai_review.review: The tape captures a quintessential early‑’70s show with a stellar set list – Morning Dew, Easy Wind and an expansive Dark Star > St. Stephen > Darkness sequence that culminates in a fiery Turn On Your Love Light. Sound quality is mixed; the first set suffers from equipment hiccups, but from Dark Star onward the audience recording is remarkably clear and immersive.

ai_rating.rationale: One detailed 5‑star review praises the musical performance heavily while noting only modest sound issues, leading to a strong overall rating but limited data for high confidence.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Overall okay sound; first set muted due to equipment trouble, second‑set (Dark Star onward) is clear and vivid with strong audience presence.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Classic ’70s set‑list with patient, jam‑heavy pacing; the second set delivers high energy and memorable transitions.
